answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the river of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the raven of a task receipt, and the pigment is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
